THAI PREMIUM STREET FOOD COMPANY LIMITED 
is engaged in the business of manufacturing and
distributing ice cream products made from Thai fruits
and frozen Thai dessert under company brand and
customer brand (Original Equipment Manufacturer or
OEM). 
THAI AWESOME COMPANY LIMITED is a manufacturer
and exporter of wet pet food, treat and supplement
products for dogs and cats. We offer a wide range of
OEM and company products, which made from the
finest raw materials that meet international standards.
NOVOCOCONUT INC. is a manufacturing company
specializing in the production and global
distribution of coconut-based products. Our core
product range includes, but is not limited to,
coconut milk, coconut water, ready-to-eat curry
soup, coconut snacks, and other allied or similar
coconut-derived products.
THAI COCONUT PUBLIC COMPANY LIMITED
is a manufacturer and distributor of a variety of
products, which are produced from coconuts and
various fruits under the customer brand (Original
Equipment Manufacturer or OEM) and our company
brand.
